name: aqhi-hourly-observations
about: The promise each day's AQHI observations must keep before Almanac loads them. Read by pipeline/contract.py; the 'plain' lines are shown on the page.

source.publisher: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Meteorological Service of Canada
source.attribution: Data Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada
source.licence: Environment and Climate Change Canada Data Services End-use Licence

checks.name: schema
checks.title: The columns are where we expect them
checks.plain: The file must have a date column, an hour column and one column for each of the seven cities. If ECCC renames or drops a column, nothing is loaded.

checks.name: types
checks.title: Every value is the right kind of thing
checks.plain: Dates must be dates, hours must be whole numbers from 0 to 23, and readings must be numbers or blank. Anything else means the format changed, so nothing is loaded.

checks.name: range
checks.title: Readings are on the AQHI scale
checks.plain: A reading must lie between 1 and 11 (the file writes the top category, 10+, as 11). Odd values are set aside; if more than 1 in 100 are odd, the day is refused.

checks.name: uniqueness
checks.title: One reading per city per hour
checks.plain: Each city may have only one reading for each hour. Exact repeats are dropped with a warning; two different readings for the same hour stop the load.

checks.name: completeness
checks.title: All 24 hours of the day are in the file
checks.plain: The source file must contain a row for every hour of the day, even if some cities are blank in it. A short day is a warning; a missing day is a failure.

checks.name: volume
checks.title: Enough cities reported
checks.plain: Each city should have a reading for at least 18 of the 24 hours. Fewer is a warning, because high-risk hours could be missed. Under half of all expected readings is a failure.

checks.name: freshness
checks.title: The source is up to date
checks.plain: When the daily run reads the live feed, its newest hour should be at most 6 hours old. Older is a warning that the feed may be stalling; no live file at all in the last 8 hours means it has stalled, and the day is refused. A backfill reads a monthly archive, so this does not apply.

slo.plain: Fresh means the newest hour on this page is at most 36 hours old and the pipeline has run in the last 26 hours.
